scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter @saleaway/web build && pnpm --filter @saleaway/web exec wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @saleaway/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply saleaway --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @saleaway/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply saleaway --remote
